evidence.note: WWMD decision DI-6E3E979EC8CE recommended publishing an auditable packet plus one-BI-per-slice execution queue over a status-only reply or a broad direct refactor. The choice keeps the UX work source-controlled, keeps Build Studio out of the path while it is unreliable, maps independently shippable work to live backlog items, and prevents a new feature from becoming another unowned portal surface.
